Commentary.Commentary: Isuru Udana will bowl from the other end
We are set for the chase! Shikhar Dhawan and Prithvi Shaw walk out to bat. The Sri Lankan fielders are already out in the middle. Dushmantha Chameera to start with the ball. Here we go..

Right then! 263 is what India need to go 1-up in the series. It is a young Indian side so it will be interesting to see how they fare against Sri Lanka. The hosts will rely on Dushmantha Chameera to provide them with early wickets at the start. This should be an exciting chase, so do join us for that in a short while!

India's bowling was dominated by the spinners. The pacers did not get a wicket at the start so it was Yuzvendra Chahal who provided them with the first wicket in the Powerplay. After that, Kuldeep Yadav took two in the same over to put them on top. The batters struggled to rotate the strike in the middle overs as the spinners bowled tight lines. Krunal Pandya took one wicket and bowled without giving many runs. Deepak Chahar took two wickets towards the fag end while Hardik Pandya and Chahal took one. But in the last two overs, they gave away 32 runs and that will give Sri Lanka some much-needed momentum. Bhuvneshwar Kumar had a tough day as he went for 63 in his 9 overs, which included an expensive 19-run last over.

Sri Lanka had a decent start with the bat as Avishka Fernando and Minod Bhanuka put on a 49-run stand. They took their time to score the runs and were looking quite solid. But Fernando fell in the 10th over. Bhanuka Rajapaksa played an entertaining knock of 24 runs but fell to Kuldeep Yadav. In the same over, Minod Bhanuka got out too and they were in big trouble. Dhananjaya de Silva and Charith Asalanka tried to repair things but de Silva fell while looking to up the ante. Asalanka and Dasun Shanaka did a decent job to make sure that they kept wickets in hand in the last few overs, but Asalanka fell in the 38th over. After that, there was a flurry of wickets and they could not capitalize in the death overs but some lusty blows by Dushmantha Chameera and Chamika Karunaratne took them to 262 and gave them much-needed momentum.

Some good hitting by Sri Lanka in the last few overs means that they have put a decent score on the board. This has been a much better batting show by them compared to what we saw in England. By India, it was mixed performance, they bowled really well in the middle overs and looked on track to skittle the hosts out for a low score, but they let things slide a bit in the death overs.

Tossed up on middle, patted back to the bowler.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa comes to bat now.
OUT! TAKEN! Yuzvendra Chahal strikes off his first ball! Loopy ball, outside off. Avishka Fernando goes for the drive but hits it straight to Manish Pandey at covers. India draw first blood!
Commentary.Howout: c Manish Pandey b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Yuzvendra Chahal comes in the attack!
FOUR! Make that two in a row! Length ball on middle, Minod Bhanuka lifts it over mid on for another boundary.
FOUR! On a length around middle, Minod Bhanuka covers the stumps and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length delivery on off. Bhanuka nudges it to mid on.
Length delivery outside off, shaping away a little late. Bhanuka lets it go for the keeper to collect.
Length ball way outside off, inside the tramline though. Bhanuka lets it sail through.
Sprays one on the pads, Fernando gets an inside edge. The ball goes off the pads towards square leg for a single.

First ball for Hardik Pandya! Good length delivery on off, a length that he loves. Fernando pushes it back to the bowler. Hardik Pandya has overstepped. Will have to reload again. Free Hit coming up...
Here we go! Hardik Pandya comes in the attack. Been a while since he has bowled.
On a length on off, Fernando guides it towards third man. He retains the strike picking up a single. Fernando was in two minds there but in the end played it without any trouble.

SIX! First six of the innings! Length ball on middle and leg, Avishka Fernando uses his bottom hand and flicks it over deep square leg for a maximum. Shouts for a ' CATCH' but this has crossed the ropes with ease.
Slower delivery outside off, shaping away. Fernando pushes it to mid off.
Back of a length outside off, Fernando drives it but straight to covers.
Touch fuller on middle, Fernando covers the stumps and nudges it to mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Fernando eases it to mid on.
Good length ball outside off, blocks it to mid off does Minod Bhanuka.
An inswinger on middle, Minod Bhanuka nudges it awkwardly towards the short mid-wicket fielder.
Defended solidly in front of mid on by Minod Bhanuka.
Short and wide, Avishka Fernando cuts it to third man and they run three before the fielder cuts it off.
Good length ball on the pads, flicked through square leg for a couple.
WIDE! Bangs a short ball on middle. Fernando ducks under it. Wide called for height.
Good length ball, defended towards the mid on fielder.
Good length ball, defended solidly by Minod Bhanuka. And it is a maiden over!
Full and wide outside off, Minod Bhanuka leaves it alone as it is too wide.
Length ball on stumps, defended to cover-point .
BEATEN! Full ball outside off, Minod Bhanuka misses the off drive, as he looks to go over mid off.
Good length ball outside off, Minod Bhanuka shoulders arms watchully.
Good length ball around the fifth stump, Minod Bhanuka leaves it alone.
On the pads now. Avishka Fernando clips it past square leg for a couple of runs.
A nice outswinger, but this starts outside off and the swing takes it further away. Wide called.
131 kmph, on a length and on off again. Avishka Fernando taps it to mid on. They think of the single for a moment but decide against it in the end.
Leaves it on a length, on off. Fernando takes a step down the track and defends it.
Full and wider outside off. Nicely punched to covers.
Length ball, around off. Avishka Fernando is very solid in his defence of this.
Serves a fuller ball, on the fourth stump. The ball moves away a touch so Fernando leaves it alone.
Back of a length, around off. Blocked out.
Length ball, outside off. Fernando looks to drive but gets it from the inner half of the bat towards square leg, for one.
Nice length ball, outside off. Fernando takes a step down the track and defends it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Punched to point by Avishka Fernando.
Short of a length on middle, Bhanuka pulls it towards deep square leg for just a single.
Weather - Currently it is cloudy and quite humid out there. Tough conditions for the players but as the sun settles, it should get more comfortable.
Length delivery on off, Fernando shuffles across and pushes it towards mid-wicket for one.
More runs! Kumar drifts on the pads now. Fernando clips it past square leg. The fielder chases it but they still get three.
Serves a length ball, outside off. Fernando shuffles on the off side and defends it.
Short of a length now, on off. Bhanuka clips it to the leg side for one.
Back of a length, around off. Defended out.
Serves a length ball, just outside off. This one leaves the left-hander and Bhanuka leaves it.
Nicely played. Length ball, on middle. Bhanuka clips it to the leg side and takes a couple.
A nice ball to finish the over. A nice outswinger, it starts on the fourth stump and moves away. Avishka Fernando leaves it.
Bowls it on a length, outside off. Avishka Fernando drives it well. The man at mid on moves to his left and dives to stop the ball.
FOUR! Punished! Chahar drifts on the pads now. Avishka Fernando accepts the gift and flicks it to the square leg fence.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Chahar searches for the swing and bowls a full one, outside off. Avishka Fernando leans into it and creams it past covers for a boundary.
A touch fuller, outside off. Avishka Fernando punches it past covers for a boundary.
Back of a length, on off. Defended out by Avishka Fernando.
Deepak Chahar to bowl from the other end.
Swings this one outside off, Bhanuka leaves it alone. 4 runs from the first over.
Back of a length on off, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Swings it down the leg side. Fernando looks to flick but misses. Wide signaled by the umpire.
On a length around off, shaping away. Fernando taps it in front of point.
Short of a length outside off, Fernando leaves it alone. A hint of swing there for Bhuvneshwar Kumar.
Full ball, outside off. Avishka Fernando decides to leave it too late and the ball takes the bottom edge.
Sri Lanka are underway! Length delivery around off, Avishka Fernando knocks it through covers. A couple of fielders run back to chase it. Two taken.

We are all set to begin! Both the teams are out now for their respective national anthems. First, it will be India's followed by Sri Lanka's. Now, the Indian fielders disperse in the field. Avishka Fernando and Minod Bhanuka will open for Sri Lanka. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to open the attack for India. Here we go...

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Avishka Fernando, Minod Bhanuka (WK), Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dhananjaya de Silva, Charith Asalanka, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Isuru Udana, Dushmantha Chameera, Lakshan Sandakan.

India (Playing XI) - Shikhar Dhawan (C), Prithvi Shaw, Ishan Kishan (WK), Manish Pandey, Suryakumar Yadav, Hardik Pandya, Krunal Pandya, Deepak Chahar, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Yuzvendra Chahal, Kuldeep Yadav.
Shikhar Dhawan says that they wanted to bat but this wicket will stay the same. Adds that Prithvi Shaw will bat at the top and Chahal and Yadav will handle the spin department.
Dasun Shanaka says that history suggests that batting first is good here. Informs that Bhanuka Rajapaksa is making his ODI debut.
TOSS - Sri Lanka have won the toss and they will bat first.

Prithvi Shaw is down for a chat, he says that it has been a long time since he has batted in an actual game and he is really looking forward to this series. Adds that there are a lot of brilliant players in India and there is plenty of competition but still it is like a family. Says that T20 and ODI are very different formats and he will look to take more time in this format. About Rahul Dravid, says that it is fantastic to work under him and he shares a lot of experience.

Breaking news - We have some news from the middle. It is from India's camp and Ishan Kishan and Suryakumar Yadav are all set to make their ODI debut. We wish them all the very best and we also wish Ishan Kishan a very happy birthday!

Fun fact - If the Chahar and Pandya brothers play together in any match of the series, then it will be the first time in 87 years that two pairs of siblings will feature in an Indian XI. The last time it happened was back in 1934 against England when Syed Wazir-Nazir Ali and CK Nayudu-CS Nayudu were in the XI.

Hello and a warm welcome to the first ODI between Sri Lanka and India in Colombo. This Indian side does not have the likes of Kohli, Pant, Bumrah, Ashwin, etc and have gone with players who have impressed in the Indian T20 League and the domestic circuit. It is also Dhawan's first time leading India and he will become the oldest player from India to make his captaincy debut today. On the other hand, Sri Lanka are coming off of a disappointing tour of England where they did not win a single game. They are also placed last in the ICC World Cup Super League table and will be desperate to move up from that position. Shanaka is set to lead the side and they will hope that a change in leadership brings a change in fortune for them. So, will we see India's B side filled with young players take the lead in the series? Or will the hosts get a much-needed win? We will find out. Stay tuned for more updates.
